subject: Fwd: Zenora vendor split + bank & PO contact changes
messages:
From: Arjun Kapoor <arjun.kapoor@zenora.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: split vendor record & update payment routing

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the onboarding help last month. A quick request — we recently closed a carve‑out and need to split Zenora into two vendor profiles in your system: Zenora Labs (current entity) and Zenora Payments LLC (new payments entity). Our treasury team also wants payments for some PO types routed to a new beneficiary account.

Attached are: a bank confirmation letter on bank letterhead, a signed W9 for Zenora Payments LLC, and a simple org chart showing the split. We’d like the following:
- Create a new vendor profile for Zenora Payments LLC with new tax/W9 and bank details
- Preserve the existing Zenora Labs profile for product/services PO routing (no change to current invoices)
- Route all license/subscription POs to Zenora Payments LLC starting 2026-09-01

Can you confirm next steps and any procurement/finance forms we should complete? If you prefer, we can run a short 15–20m call this week to walk through.

Thanks,
Arjun Kapoor
Head of Finance Ops
Zenora Labs
attachments: zenora_bank_change_letter.pdf (pdf), zenora_w9_signed.pdf (pdf), zenora_internal_org_chart.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Kapoor <arjun.kapoor@zenora.co>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: split vendor record & update payment routing

Hi Arjun —

Appreciate the documents and context. Quick answers and next steps:

1) We can create a separate vendor profile for Zenora Payments LLC and route subscription/license POs to that profile effective 2026-09-01.

2) Procurement needs: a) completed supplier change form (linked below), b) ACH verification (micro‑deposit or bank letter — you provided a bank letter which is fine), and c) confirmation of who should be the portal admin for the new vendor record.

3) Finance (cc’d) will perform the bank verification and assign the vendor code; procurement will record the PO routing policy.

Please fill out the supplier change form here: https://redwoodapp.example.com/procurement/requests/REQ-7812 (select "vendor split / new remit entity"). When complete, reply to this thread and we’ll queue the finance checks.

If useful, happy to book a 20m call Wednesday afternoon — I have 2:30–3:30pm PT open.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Zenora vendor split + bank & PO contact changes — finance verify please

Folks — forwarding Zenora’s request. They provided a bank letter and signed W9 for the new payments entity. Can Finance validate the bank letter and let procurement know whether micro‑deposits are required? Also need a quick confirmation on cutover process (how we map old vendor → new vendor for POs and whether any open invoices will be affected).

Attachments: zenora_bank_change_letter.pdf, zenora_w9_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Neha

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Zenora vendor split + bank & PO contact changes — finance verify please

On Tue, 17 Aug 2026 at 09:05 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Zenora’s request. They provided a bank letter and signed W9 for the new payments entity. Can Finance validate the bank letter and let procurement know whether micro‑deposits are required? Also need a quick confirmation on cutover process (how we map old vendor → new vendor for POs and whether any open invoices will be affected).

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the bank letter and the account details look consistent with the W9. Per our risk policy, we still require either a test micro‑deposit or a bank‑issued ACH confirmation letter showing the last four digits. The supplied bank letter is on official letterhead but does not show the account suffix; ask them to either: 1) provide a bank confirmation with the account last‑4, OR 2) complete our micro‑deposit flow (we’ll send two small amounts to verify).

Regarding cutover: procurement can set an effective date where new POs will reference the new vendor code. Open invoices submitted to Zenora Labs should continue to be paid out of Zenora Labs unless the supplier provides signed remittance instructions authorizing reallocation — we typically avoid re‑posting historical invoices. Recommend: set effective date 2026‑09‑01 for new POs, and request a signed remittance authorization if they want us to move outstanding invoices to the new account.

I can run the micro‑deposit flow if they opt in — will need contact name + email for the treasury person.

Jonas
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Kapoor <arjun.kapoor@zenora.co>, billing@zenora.co
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: split vendor record & update payment routing — next steps and timeline

Hi Arjun —

Thanks for the quick turnaround here. Per finance request, could you please provide either:
1) a bank confirmation letter that includes the account last‑4 digits, OR
2) the contact for the treasury person who can receive micro‑deposits (name + email).

Once we have that we’ll:
- Open a new vendor record for Zenora Payments LLC (vendor code will be shared when created)
- Set PO routing so license/subscription POs are issued to the new vendor effective 2026‑09‑01
- Leave Zenora Labs vendor profile as the payee for all currently open invoices unless you provide signed remittance reallocation instructions

If you prefer the micro‑deposit path, reply with the treasury contact and I’ll trigger the verification; if you’ll send an updated bank letter, upload to the DocuSign link here: https://app.docusign.com/templates/zenora-bank-update

Planner: target completion by 2026‑08‑26 for finance verification so we can meet the 2026‑09‑01 PO cutover.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: supplier_change_form_link (online), procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf)
